name: Dinakaran S
title: Team Lead - Banking Operations / Static Data
summary: Banking operations professional with experience in static data management, trade support, rate administration, and process control within high-volume financial services environments. Proven ability to lead BAU operations, support change testing, and maintain strong compliance standards across critical reference data activities. Combines operational accuracy with growing interest in technology-enabled process improvement, workflow automation, and data-driven reporting.

highlights: Lead BAU static data activities across rate management and administrative processes supporting trade-related operations.
Manage Forex rate updates, FTP updates, and Liquidity Premium rate maintenance to ensure timely and accurate downstream processing.
Handle SWIFT account creation and amendments with strong focus on control, accuracy, and turnaround time.
Create and amend charge codes in line with business requirements and operational standards.
Supported UVT testing for new implementations and process changes to validate readiness before rollout.
Drive process improvement and support regulatory compliance by strengthening controls and refining workflows.
Supported digital advertising execution across text and visual ads for LED module products.
Worked directly with clients to gather requirements and maintain delivery communication.
Built strong coordination and execution skills in a deadline-driven environment.
Performed research and data entry tasks with high attention to accuracy and consistency.
Supported information workflows requiring dependable turnaround and detail-oriented execution.
